title: Celestea Studio HTTP API contract (43 endpoints)

source.routes: /src/celestea_studio/src/main.rs:1333-1376 (38 route() declarations = 43 method+path, minus 4 static = 39 API endpoints)
source.routeTable: W516 added 4 TypeScript-only endpoints (GET|POST|DELETE /api/sessions/{id}/grants + GET /api/sessions/{id}/grants/confirm-token); the retired Rust reference has no counterpart (see contracts/rust-route-table.snapshot.json tsOnlyRoutes).

conventions.responseBody: JSON (application/json) except SSE and static assets
conventions.errorBody: {"ok": false, "error": "<verbatim source string>"} (a few handlers return only {"error": ...})
conventions.requestBody: POST endpoints declaring Json<T> reject missing/non-JSON/missing-required before the handler (415/400/422)
conventions.sessionId: "<workspace>/<session>"; '/' in path params MUST be %2F encoded
conventions.singleConcurrency: every write endpoint that swaps a generation or compacts grabs the busy slot and returns 409 while a turn runs

errorCodes.400: invalid parameters (empty, format, non-absolute/nonexistent path, id shape, active-session protection)
errorCodes.405: path exists but method mismatch (axum default)
errorCodes.409: conflict: turn running (busy slot), duplicate registration, target exists, already archived
errorCodes.415: request body missing / not JSON (axum Json rejection)
errorCodes.500: persist failure / compose failure / IO failure
errorCodes.502: worker tool hard dispatch failure ONLY (src/api.rs:419-433)
